facts.text: The project is a Python program that controls a syringe pump system developed at CHX
The controller is one class, pump, which opens the serial port in its constructor
The constructor defaults to port COM10, 19200 baud and a one-second timeout
A command is the text plus a carriage return (0x0D) written to the serial port
Pump discovery writes '<address>ADR' for each address in range(tot_range) and keeps the addresses that answer
The direction query is '<address>DIR'; a WDR reply means withdraw
set_direction writes '<address>DIR<INF|WDR>', where INF is in and WDR is withdraw
set_rate first writes '<address>DIR<INF|WDR>', chosen by the sign of the flow rate
set_rate then writes '<address>RAT<the first five characters of the absolute rate><unit>' and its default unit token is UM*
set_diameter writes '<address>DIA<diameter>' and get_diameter writes '<address>DIA' and returns reply[4:-1]; the clone states no unit for this value
set_volume writes '<address>VOL <volume>' with a space after VOL and ignores its unit argument
get_volume writes '<address>VOL', parses the value from reply[4:-3] and the unit from reply[-3:-1]
get_dispense writes '<address>DIS' and parses the INF value from reply[5:10], the WDR value from reply[11:16] and the unit from reply[-3:-1]
reset_dispense writes '<address>CLD <direction>' with a space after CLD
get_rate queries '<address>DIR' and '<address>RAT'; a WDR direction gives a negative sign and a UM reply unit is labelled ul/min
run sends 'RUN' with an optional string pump prefix; its docstring says the pump is '00' or '01', set by setup on the controller panel
stop sends 'STP' with an optional string pump prefix; the same docstring applies
The other per-pump commands format the pump number with %i (an integer, no zero padding)
The module opens COM10 at import time through the module-level variable s
Line 48 is a Python 2 print statement, so the module does not import under Python 3
